result.summary: The page has a major layout issue where cards in the top carousel are misaligned vertically due to inconsistent image heights. There is also a minor visual issue with a badge blending into its background.

issues.description: The cards in the "Fastest near you" horizontal scroll row have inconsistent heights. Because the background images have different natural aspect ratios, the text beneath them (e.g., "Green Bowl Poké" vs "Smash Bros Burgers") is misaligned vertically, creating a jagged, broken-looking carousel.
issues.suggestion: Set all cards (or their image containers) in the carousel to a uniform height and use `object-fit: cover` for the images so the bottom content aligns on a single baseline.

issues.description: The "15-25 min" delivery time badge on the "Green Bowl Poké" card is a white pill placed over a mostly white food image, making the badge boundaries nearly invisible and the text harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a semi-transparent dark background for the badge or add a stronger drop shadow to ensure it stands out against light-colored imagery.
